_note: EMBEDDED dependency spec — the checksum trust anchor (ships inside the code-signed installer). Windows-first; macOS keeps bundling this slice, so no macOS entries yet (the schema supports platform:'macos' for later adoption). LIVE deps are hosted on the public GitHub repo GarniczAndrzej/reel-automator-deps with real pinned SHA-256: the CPU engine + FFmpeg on release deps-v1.0.0, and the GPU engine on release deps-v1.1.0. The GPU engine (`engine-gpu-windows-x86_64`) is the CT2-CUDA + torch-CPU build with the two cuBLAS DLLs baked in — it froze to ~1.03 GB (down from the 3.08 GB cu128 build), which fits under GitHub's 2 GB per-asset cap, so it is hosted and pinned exactly like the CPU engine. `engine-gpu-full-windows-x86_64` is an OPT-IN escape hatch: the full CUDA-torch build (3.08 GB, GPU alignment + diarization). It exceeds GitHub's 2 GB per-asset cap, so it is hosted on a public HuggingFace bucket (Vndrew/ReelAutomatorGPUfull, /buckets/.../resolve/<file>?download=true → public Xet CDN) and pinned with a real SHA-256. It is reachable ONLY via REEL_ENGINE_VARIANT=gpu-full — never auto-selected by hardware detection and deliberately absent from the UI variant dropdown (see plan 'What We're NOT Doing'), so the dropdown stays honest about what a normal install downloads. ALIGN MODELS ARE NOT A MANAGED DEPENDENCY: the wav2vec2 align model is no longer downloaded/staged via this spec — the engine pulls it from the OFFICIAL HuggingFace repo (jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-polish) into the default HF cache at first transcription (see whisper.rs: HF-offline is only forced when a local align dir is present). An empty sha256 means 'not yet pinned' → the downloader fail-closes and REFUSES to stage that artifact (safe default). To pin a new artifact: upload at its versioned URL, compute SHA-256 (`Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256` / `sha256sum`), replace `url` + `sha256` (+ verify `sizeBytes`).
